build_ddpppo_agent: build a decentralized distributed PPO agent by instantiating the DDPPO class
create_distributed_mean_var: create a function that computes mean and variance of a tensor across distributed workers
init_distributed_training: initialize distributed training for the model by calling init_distributed on the DDPPO agent
compute_distributed_advantages: compute normalized advantages across distributed workers using _get_advantages_distributed with rollouts
evaluate_actions_ddp: evaluate policy actions through the DDP wrapper using _evaluate_actions with observations and masks
